2112595517171761202.en_summary: Conflicting narratives around $TTWO; still bullish on GTA 6 but unsure how much the market will care about the game’s initial success versus broader fears about the future of gaming, especially with recent explosion in AI-assisted game decompilation. GTA 6 could outperform expectations and the stock could still struggle.
